spans.s: AT0012 अधो भागं तुमूलजम् adho bhāgaṁ tumūlajam Gangadhar commentary on charak samhita says the tendency of poisons of plant origin is to move downwards in the body.
AF0106 अधोगुरुत्व नाभेः adhogurutva nābheḥ Heaviness below the umbilicus.
SV0016 अधोभक्त adhobhakta Administration of oral medication immediately after taking food. Such administration of medicine is advised for strengthening the body and to make person stout.
SR0016 अधोभागः adhobhāgaḥ lower abdomen -Lower part of the portion of the trunk located between chest and pelvis
RS0005 अधोमुखी adhomukhī keeping mouth of the vessel downwards/Upside down
AT0013 अधोवक्त्रः adhovaktraḥ Drooping of head, symptom of a rabid dog.
AF0107 अधोवदनशयन adhovadanaśayana Inclination to lie always on prone position
